record.paper_title: Boundary and Defect CFT: Open Problems and Applications
record.original_question: How can the analytic-bootstrap approach used for loop corrections in AdS5 × S5 be combined either with direct one-loop Witten-diagram computations or with integrability-based methods, so that the different approaches constrain and check one another?

evidence.quote: Other interesting directions would be to combine the method presented in this note with recent direct computations of Witten diagrams at one loop [150] and with integrability based approaches [151].

artifact.status_search_result: The question is a research-program proposal about integrating three computational frameworks for one-loop holographic correlators in AdS_5 × S^5. While progress has been made in each individual approach and partial comparisons exist, a complete unified framework combining all approaches with full mutual consistency checks remains an active research direction and is not known to be fully achieved.
